items.title: Colombia: 13 dead in illegal gold mine collapse
items.description: Another seven people were injured and all those missing have been accounted for. Accidents at unregulated mines are fairly common in Colombia.

items.title: Taliban release two detained UN staff members in Afghanistan
items.description: The two men, detained in the western city of Herat on August 9, were released on Thursday morning.

items.title: Brethren Church denies paying influencers to harass election candidates
items.description: The Plymouth Brethren Christian Church says it did not pay or coordinate with far-right influencers to harass and intimidate candidates during last year's federal election, following allegations published in Nine newspapers.

items.title: Socialist surge: On the rise of democratic socialism in the U.S.
items.description: Affordability issues propel democratic socialists in the U.S.

items.title: Probe into whether police 'code' led to hiker being declared alive
items.description: Emergency services are investigating whether a miscommunication about a police code may have led to hiker Lily Hooper being incorrectly identified as alive.
